description: This file contains the implementation of the ClusterClient class, which manages communication with Orleans clusters, handles lifecycle events, and provides methods to create and retrieve grain references, as well as lifecycle management functions.

classes.name: ClusterClient
classes.description: Represents a client for connecting and interacting with Orleans clusters, managing lifecycle events, and creating grain references.

methods.name: ClusterClient
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ClusterClient with dependencies, sets up lifecycle participants, and validates configuration.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously starts the runtime client and triggers the start lifecycle event.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously performs shutdown routines, including logging, lifecycle stop, and runtime client shutdown.

methods.name: GetGrain
methods.description: Retrieves a grain reference of specified type and primary key.

methods.name: CreateObjectReference
methods.description: Creates a client-side object reference for the specified grain observer or addressable object.

methods.name: DeleteObjectReference
methods.description: Deletes a client-side object reference for the specified grain observer.

methods.name: ServiceProvider
methods.description: Provides access to the service provider used within the runtime client.
